transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um, hi. I'm here because... well, I'm having trouble at work. I work at a meat processing plant, and... I keep messing up the paperwork. Like, I'll start the sanitation steps, or the batch logs, or the end-of-line stuff, and I just... I somehow leave out the last parts. Even though I know I have to finish them right. It's becoming a problem.
Have you had trouble paying attention or finishing tasks since you were a child?

Um... yeah, I guess so. My mom actually still has some of my old report cards from around fourth grade. They said I was bright, but... I always needed constant reminders to finish things. Like classwork, or turning in my homework. 

I understood the lessons fine, I just... I'd miss chunks of the instructions. Unless the teacher was standing right next to me, I guess.
Do you have the same kind of trouble finishing things in other parts of your life besides work?
Um... not really, no. I mean, work is the main issue right now. I don't know about other stuff.
Outside of work, do you also have trouble finishing everyday tasks?
Um... no, I don't think so. Like I said, it's mostly just work. I don't really... I mostly just go to my job and come home. There's not much else going on that I'd need to finish.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think I'm depressed or anything. Just... frustrated with work, I guess. But no.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge at work?
Um... no. Not really. I don't feel anxious or anything. Just... like I said, it's just hard to get my work done. But no.
Have you had any head injury or illness affecting your brain?
Um... no. I haven't had any head injuries or... anything like that. No.
Have these attention or finishing problems ever caused you trouble at home?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, my apartment's a bit messy, but... it's fine. It's just work that's the problem.
Have these mistakes at work ever gotten you written up or formally warned by your supervisor?

Um... yeah. Sort of. They... they pulled me in for some retraining meetings recently. And... sometimes the other people on the line have to cover parts of my work. It's... I don't know. I'm just worried they're going to move me off the line, or... fire me. I don't want them thinking I'm a safety concern. I just want to be reliable.
Have these same attention or unfinished-task problems ever caused trouble in school or any job before this one?

Um... yeah, I guess. School was... kind of the same. 

My mom actually kept some old report cards from, like, fourth grade. They always said I was bright, but... they said I needed constant reminders to finish things or turn in my homework. I mean, I understood the lessons fine. I just... I'd miss parts of the instructions unless the teacher was standing right there. So... yeah, it's happened before.
Do these same problems with finishing things ever cause trouble in your relationships?
Um... no. Not really. I don't... I don't really have anyone to bother with that kind of stuff right now. So, no.
Do you ever leave chores at home unfinished?
Um... I don't know. I guess I do sometimes. But... it's just my own place, so it doesn't really matter.
Have these same attention or unfinished-task problems ever caused trouble in managing everyday things at home, like paying bills on time?
Um... no, not really. I mean, my bills are just set to autopay, so... I don't really have to think about them. They just kind of handle themselves.
When you're doing things at home, do you also often lose track of what you were doing and leave it unfinished?
Um... I'm not sure. I guess maybe? I just... I don't really pay attention to that kind of thing.
Do you have the same trouble staying focused and finishing tasks when you're not at work?
I don't really know. When I'm not at work, I just... I don't really do much that needs a lot of focus, I guess. I just sort of hang out.
Have you ever had this same kind of trouble focusing or finishing tasks in any job before this one?
Um... I don't really know. I haven't... I haven't really had that many jobs before this one, so... I can't really say.
Do you also make this kind of mistake when you're doing things that need steps outside of work, like following a recipe?
I don't... I mean, I don't really cook much. So I'm not sure. I usually just stick to easy things, so... I haven't really noticed.
Before this job, did these same attention problems ever get you in trouble in any other part of your life besides school and this job?
Um... not really. I don't think so. I mostly just... kept to myself, outside of school. So I didn't really get in trouble or anything.
Did teachers ever have to give you extra help or reminders because you had trouble finishing your schoolwork?

Um... yeah, I guess. My mom... she actually still has some of my old report cards. Like from fourth grade, I think. They usually said I was... bright, but I needed a lot of reminders to finish my work. Or to turn it in. I understood what we were doing, I just... I'd miss parts of the instructions unless the teacher was, like, right there. So... yeah, they did.
Do these same attention problems make it hard for you to keep your apartment clean?
Um... I don't really know. I guess my apartment is mostly fine. I haven't really noticed it being a big problem, so... yeah.
